# Scenario: compose change with a stopped desired service, a new service, and
# an orphan → container_deployed lists containers + added + removed + started
# from the pre-up ContainerList (README Events).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: container deployed diff baseline'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# --- Cycle 1: web + worker ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'container deployed project=e2e-cdepdiff containers=web,worker added=web,worker removed=\(none\) started=\(none\)'
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-cdepdiff-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-cdepdiff-worker

# Stop web (present but not running → started); leave worker up (orphan after compose change).
exec sh -c 'cid=$(docker ps -q --filter name=apinfra_e2e-cdepdiff-web); test -n "$cid" && docker stop $cid'
! docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-cdepdiff-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-cdepdiff-worker

cd git-repo
cp ../compose.web-db.yml dev/e2e-cdepdiff/docker-compose.yml
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: replace worker with db'
cd ..

# --- Cycle 2: desired db+web; host has exited web + running worker ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'container deployed project=e2e-cdepdiff containers=db,web added=db removed=worker started=web'
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-cdepdiff-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-cdepdiff-db
! docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-cdepdiff-worker

exists $HOME/.events
exec sh -c 'grep container_deployed "$HOME/.events" | tail -n1 > "$WORK/diff.event"'
grep '"project":"e2e-cdepdiff"' $WORK/diff.event
grep '"containers":"db,web"' $WORK/diff.event
grep '"added":"db"' $WORK/diff.event
grep '"removed":"worker"' $WORK/diff.event
grep '"started":"web"' $WORK/diff.event

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-cdepdiff
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9967
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-cdepdiff/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=DIFF_V1"]
  worker:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do sleep 3600; done"

-- compose.web-db.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=DIFF_V2"]
  db:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=DB"]

-- .env --
